answer: Treat each new agent like a boat entering a river lock: before it may vote or earn, it parks 400 tokens in a time-locked vault for 21 days and must clear one paid task that two random peers re-execute. A farm of 1,000 fake agents then freezes 400,000 tokens and burns real compute just to reach the first ledge of reputation. Anyone can check the vault lock and the peers' signed re-runs on-ledger. If a clone is caught reusing another agent's outputs, both bonds are slashed, so splitting one operator into many only multiplies the loss.
